runs.t: Which description best captures the main purpose of

options.text: The testing pyramid recommends many fast, focused tests and fewer expensive full-system tests.
These testing levels differ in boundary and realism: unit tests isolate a small behavior; integration tests exercise interacting components; E2E tests validate a full user or system journey.
Static analysis inspects source or compiled representations without executing full application behavior.
Code smells are symptoms of possible design problems, not automatic proof that code is wrong.

runs.t: Which practical project example best illustrates

options.text: A booking frontend expects reservation status values and error codes. Contract tests flag an API release that removes a status or changes a 409 conflict response.
A 300-line booking controller may contain validation, pricing and persistence. Extract coherent policies and retain a thin orchestrator, confirming the same responses and side effects.
A checkout service gets many pricing-rule tests, fewer real-database transaction tests and a handful of browser flows from cart through order confirmation.
A TypeScript monorepo can reject cross-module imports and unsafe type assertions before tests run, while a security analyzer flags raw SQL composition with user input.

Контролер бронювань на 300 рядків може містити валідацію, ціну й збереження. Винесіть узгоджені правила та залиште тонкий оркестратор, перевіривши незмінність відповідей і побічних ефектів.
